scanNote:
GRAMMAR REFERENCE, 5-BET (120-bet). Yuqorida chapda 'Grammar Reference'.

CHAP USTUN:
Yashil 'UNIT 5'. 'WILL'. YaShIL JADVAL: Affirmative - Long form: I will leave, you will leave, he will leave, she will leave, it will leave, we will leave, you will leave, they will leave. Short form: I'll leave, you'll leave, he'll leave, she'll leave, it'll leave, we'll leave, you'll leave, they'll leave. Interrogative: Will I leave? Will you leave? ... Will they leave? Negative - Long form: I will not leave ... they will not leave. Short form: I won't leave ... they won't leave. Short answers: Yes, I/you/he etc will. No, I/you/he etc won't.
'Form': • We form the future simple with will and the base form of the verb. 'He will go to the park. They will go to the beach.' • We form questions by putting will before the subject pronoun. 'Will he go to the park? Will they go to the beach?' • We form negations by putting not after will. 'He will not/won't go to the park. They will not/won't go to the beach.'

O'NG USTUN:
'Use': We use will: • to make predictions based on what we believe or think. We usually use will with I think, I believe, I expect, probably. 'There will be rain in Paris tomorrow.' • to make on-the-spot decisions. 'A: The phone is ringing. B: I'll answer it.'
OCh YaShIL QUTI: 'Time expressions used with the future simple: tomorrow, soon, next week/month/etc, the day after tomorrow etc.'
'BE GOING TO'. YaShIL QUTI 'Talking about plans and intentions': Affirmative: I am/You are/He is etc going to buy a car. Negative: I'm not/You aren't/He isn't etc going to buy a car. Interrogative: Am I/Are you/Is he etc going to buy a car? Short answers: Yes, I am/you are/he is etc. No, I'm not/you aren't/he isn't etc.
'Form': • We form the affirmative with the verb to be (is, am, are), going to and the base form of the verb. 'He is going to visit his friends.' • We form questions by putting the verb to be before the subject pronoun. 'Is he going to visit his friends?' • We form negations by putting not after the verb to be. 'He is not/isn't going to visit his friends.'
'Use': We use be going to: • for plans and intentions. 'I am going to join a gym next week.' • for predictions based on what we see or we know. 'Look at the dark clouds! It's going to rain.'

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '120'.

exercises.instructionEn: Will. Affirmative: I will (I'll) leave. Interrogative: Will I leave? Negative: I will not (won't) leave. Short answers: Yes, I will. / No, I won't. We form the future simple with will and the base form of the verb.
exercises.instructionUz: Will. Tasdiq: I will (I'll) leave. So'roq: Will I leave? Inkor: I will not (won't) leave. Qisqa javoblar: Yes, I will. / No, I won't. Kelasi oddiy zamonni will va fe'lning asosiy shakli bilan yasaymiz.
exercises.explanationUz:
WILL - KELASI ODDIY ZAMON.

  WILL + FE'L (asosiy shakl) -
  HAMMA shaxsda bir xil!


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ShAKLI                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  TASDIQ: I will leave = I'll leave
    he will leave = he'll leave
  SO'ROQ: Will he leave?
  INKOR: he will not leave = he
    WON'T leave
  QISQA: Yes, I will. / No, I
    won't.

  ⚠ 'will' dan keyin 'to' YO'Q:
  'will go' ('will to go' EMAS).
  ⚠ Qisqa ijobiy javobda 'I'll'
  EMAS: 'Yes, I will.'


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  IShLATILIShI                    ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  1 BAShORAT (fikr, ishonch
    asosida) - I think, I believe,
    I expect, probably bilan:
    'There WILL BE rain in Paris
     tomorrow.'
    'I think he'll win.'

  2 ShU ZAHOTI QAROR (on-the-spot):
    A: The phone is ringing.
    B: I'LL ANSWER it.


VAQT IBORALARI:
  tomorrow = ertaga
  soon = tez orada
  next week/month = kelasi hafta/oy
  the day after tomorrow = indinga


⚠ 'WON'T':

  = will not. /wəʊnt/.


⚠ 'A PREDICTION':

  = bashorat.


⚠ 'ON-THE-SPOT':

  = shu zahoti, o'sha joyda.

points.en: We form the future simple with will and the base form of the verb. He will go to the park. They will go to the beach.
points.uz: Kelasi oddiy zamonni will va fe'lning asosiy shakli bilan yasaymiz. U bog'ga boradi. Ular plyajga boradi.

points.en: We form questions by putting will before the subject pronoun. Will he go to the park? We form negations by putting not after will. He will not/won't go to the park.
points.uz: Savollarni will ni ega olmoshidan oldin qo'yib yasaymiz. U bog'ga boradimi? Inkorni will dan keyin not qo'yib yasaymiz. U bog'ga bormaydi.

points.en: We use will to make predictions based on what we believe or think. We usually use will with I think, I believe, I expect, probably. There will be rain in Paris tomorrow.
points.uz: Will ni ishonch yoki fikrimiz asosida bashorat qilish uchun ishlatamiz. Odatda I think, I believe, I expect, probably bilan. Ertaga Parijda yomg'ir bo'ladi.

points.en: We use will to make on-the-spot decisions. A: The phone is ringing. B: I'll answer it.
points.uz: Will ni shu zahoti qaror qilish uchun ishlatamiz. A: Telefon jiringlayapti. B: Men javob beraman.

points.en: Time expressions used with the future simple: tomorrow, soon, next week/month/etc, the day after tomorrow etc.
points.uz: Kelasi oddiy zamon vaqt iboralari: ertaga, tez orada, kelasi hafta/oy, indinga.

exercises.instructionEn: Be going to - talking about plans and intentions. Affirmative: I am/You are/He is going to buy a car. Negative: I'm not/You aren't/He isn't going to buy a car. Interrogative: Am I/Are you/Is he going to buy a car? Short answers: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
exercises.instructionUz: Be going to - rejalar va niyatlar haqida. Tasdiq: I am/You are/He is going to buy a car. Inkor: I'm not/You aren't/He isn't going to buy a car. So'roq: Am I/Are you/Is he going to buy a car? Qisqa javoblar: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
exercises.explanationUz:
BE GOING TO - REJA va NIYaT.

  BE (am/is/are) + GOING TO + FE'L


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ShAKLI                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  TASDIQ: He IS going to visit his
    friends.
  SO'ROQ: IS he going to visit his
    friends?
  INKOR: He ISN'T going to visit
    his friends.
  QISQA: Yes, he is. / No, he
    isn't.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  IShLATILIShI                    ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  1 REJALAR va NIYaTLAR (oldindan
    qaror qilingan):
    'I AM GOING TO join a gym next
     week.'

  2 BAShORAT - KO'RGAN/BILGAN
    narsamiz asosida:
    'Look at the dark clouds! It'S
     GOING TO rain.'


⚠ WILL va BE GOING TO FARQI:

  WILL:
    - fikr asosida bashorat ('I
      think it will rain')
    - shu zahoti qaror ('I'll
      answer it')
  BE GOING TO:
    - oldindan reja ('I'm going to
      join a gym')
    - dalil asosida bashorat ('dark
      clouds - it's going to rain')


⚠ 'AN INTENTION':

  = niyat.


⚠ 'TO JOIN A GYM':

  = sport zaliga a'zo bo'lmoq.

points.en: We form the affirmative with the verb to be (is, am, are), going to and the base form of the verb. He is going to visit his friends.
points.uz: Tasdiqni 'to be' fe'li (is, am, are), going to va fe'lning asosiy shakli bilan yasaymiz. U do'stlarinikiga bormoqchi.

points.en: We form questions by putting the verb to be before the subject pronoun. Is he going to visit his friends? We form negations by putting not after the verb to be. He is not/isn't going to visit his friends.
points.uz: Savollarni 'to be' fe'lini ega olmoshidan oldin qo'yib yasaymiz. U do'stlarinikiga bormoqchimi? Inkorni 'to be' dan keyin not qo'yib yasaymiz. U do'stlarinikiga bormoqchi emas.

points.en: We use be going to for plans and intentions. I am going to join a gym next week.
points.uz: Be going to ni rejalar va niyatlar uchun ishlatamiz. Kelasi hafta sport zaliga a'zo bo'lmoqchiman.

points.en: We use be going to for predictions based on what we see or we know. Look at the dark clouds! It's going to rain.
points.uz: Be going to ni ko'rgan yoki bilgan narsamiz asosida bashorat qilish uchun ishlatamiz. Qora bulutlarga qara! Yomg'ir yog'adi.

patterns.exampleEn: I think there will be rain tomorrow.
The phone is ringing. - I'll answer it.
I am going to join a gym next week.
patterns.exampleUz: Kelasi hafta sport zaliga a'zo bo'lmoqchiman.

patterns.formula: Look at X! It's going to + FE'L.
patterns.exampleEn: Look at the dark clouds! It's going to rain.
